name: Free Disk Space (Ubuntu)
description: A configurable GitHub Action to free up disk space on an Ubuntu GitHub Actions runner.

large-packages.description: Remove large misc. packages — includes azure-cli, Chrome, Firefox, PowerShell, mono, and the llvm-, php-, mongodb-, mysql-, dotnet- and aspnetcore- package fami

preinstalled-runtimes.description: Remove pre-installed runtimes (Node, Go, Python, Ruby). ⚠️ Workflows using actions/setup-node, setup-python, setup-go or setup-ruby will re-download their runti

tool-cache.description: DEPRECATED — renamed to `preinstalled-runtimes`. Still honoured, and will keep working until v3.0.0; it prints a warning when used.

swap-storage.description: Remove swap storage. ⚠️ Jobs that need swap may be killed under memory pressure, with no error mentioning this action — see #12. Off by default for that reason.
